label: caiso164 zonal loss surface
definition: caiso164 zonal loss surface: CAISO measured marginal delivery-factor surface (dev_z=sum(MCL_z)/sum(MCE) from CAISO's own published DAM component record) on the internal N-S links, one-way loss pairs. Rule 14 [R-ACCURATE] measured-over-estimate; the LP was lossless. Bounded ex ante at the measured dMCL (19.8/12.8/18.3% of the NP15-ZP26 basis); NOT a fix for the congestion majority.
